fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Trailing Thread
fusions.desc: Casts a trailing thread at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Padded Gait
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 18% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Puttees
fusions.desc: Conjures wound leg-wraps: your movement speed rises by 8%, your critical chance by 3%, your critical hits deal 10% more damage, and each kill returns 2 health.
